_comment: WXAI dual-arm differential-drive contract. Dimension meanings are mirrored in lmm/policy/wxai_transforms.py, which is the executable source of truth; this file exists so the contract is reviewable without reading code.

embodiment.note: NOT Mobile ALOHA. Not dual ViperX, not a Slate omnidirectional base.

delta_action_mask_note: 14 elements, not 16. DeltaActions computes dims=len(mask) and indexes state[..., :dims]; state is 14-D, so a 16-element mask raises. The prefix stopping at 14 is what keeps base dims absolute.

normalization.note: trossen / trossen_mobile statistics describe dual ViperX arms and a Slate omnidirectional base. They are dimensionally compatible (14-D state, 16-D action) but semantically wrong for WXAI, and dims 14-15 have been redefined from vx/vy to forward/yaw. New statistics MUST be computed from WXAI data before fine-tuning.

control.note: Nominal only. Habitat step rate and arm+base step splitting have not been measured; StepResult.sim_steps reports the actual simulator cost per policy action.
